summary: Operating Expenses (المصروفات التشغيلية اليومية) feature is fully working end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 new pytest tests pass — CRUD for salaries/rentals/daily, summary aggregates by category (employee/household/charity), report endpoint daily/monthly/yearly, dashboard integration (operating_expenses_total + 3 sub-totals, net_profit deduction), stopped salaries & expired rentals correctly excluded, net_sales_config.deduct_operating_expenses toggle persists (default True). Frontend: sidebar nav-operating-expenses link present and navigates to /operating-expenses; page shows 4 tabs (salaries/rentals/daily/report) and 7 summary cards; full Create/Edit/Delete cycle on Salaries, Rental Create, Daily expense Create all work end-to-end; Report tab renders 4 sub-cards; Settings page exposes the new toggle and saves successfully; Dashboard markup contains the 3 new operating KPI markers.
critical_code_review_comments: expenses_routes.py: clean module, async DB usage, _id excluded everywhere via {'_id': 0}, Pydantic input validation, proper 400/404 error codes — no issues found.
_daily_from_monthly rounds each per-record per-day cost to 4 decimals before summation; expected behavior, matches test math within ±0.05 SAR.
Rental update: PUT correctly re-validates start/end coherence when either field is changed — good.

compute_operating_expenses_for_range iterates day-by-day; OK for current ranges but if a user ever requests a multi-year range it could become slow. Optional future optimization: closed-form monthly aggregation. Not a blocker now.

Frontend OperatingExpenses.jsx: all interactive elements have data-testid (oe-* prefix), modal CRUD works, status badges render correctly. The Salaries-row delete uses window.confirm — acceptable but consider a styled modal for consistency with the rest of the app.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (sidebar nav, page tabs, summary cards, salary CRUD, rental create, daily create, report tab, settings toggle, dashboard markers)

test_credentials: admin@hesab.app / admin123 works. UI test auto-registered fresh user test_oe_<rand>@hesab.app / test12345.
seed_data_creation: Each pytest test registers an ephemeral user TEST_op_<uuid>@hesab.app. UI test created and cleaned up one salary, then created one rental and one daily-expense for that throwaway user. No production data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Operating Expenses feature is shipped and verified. Pytest path: /app/backend/tests/test_operating_expenses.py. Frontend testid contract: nav-operating-expenses (sidebar), operating-expenses-page, oe-tabs / oe-tab-{salaries|rentals|daily|report}, oe-summary with 7 child cards, oe-{salary|rental|daily}-row-{id} for rows, oe-edit-btn / oe-delete-btn for row actions, oe-modal-{salary|rental|daily} for modals, oe-modal-submit / oe-modal-close, oe-{salary|rental|daily}-* for form fields, net-sales-toggle-deduct_operating_expenses on Settings. Dashboard exposes operating_expenses_total, operating_salaries_total, operating_rentals_total, operating_daily_other_total in /api/dashboard.totals and net_profit is reduced by operating_expenses_total. Salary categories: employee/household/charity. Rental property_types: office/warehouse/shop/employee_housing/other. Salary status: active/stopped. Rental status: active/expired. Daily cost math: salary monthly/days_in_month, rental annual/365.
